summary: Younger brother of Friedrich Mayer who died at Munzingen in 1857, aged nineteen; John's 4th-great-uncle.
bio: Johann Baptist Alois Mayer was born at Munzingen, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany, on 16 June 1838, a younger brother of John's ancestor Friedrich Mayer. He died at Munzingen on 25 June 1857, aged nineteen, a month after the death of his sister Carolina.
